summary: Phase-4 independent master challenge examined all ten discovery reconciliation items, eleven attacker paths, thirty-two flow contexts, fifteen specialist/privilege records, eight attacker integration answers and all recorded gaps/not-applicable claims. Eleven sealed artifacts and original work form passed SHA-256 integrity checks. The three retained candidates—last-ward governance lockout, approval replacement allowance race and uncertain live ward/domain binding—lack decisive machine/deployed evidence; fifty-seven class checks remain execution-pending rather than proved safe. Independent delegated test-executor must run positive/negative controls, observe real raw assertions, distinguish local fixture from frozen Ethereum chain-1 deployment, measure economic outcomes and preserve incomplete configuration questions explicitly. No master acceptance is permitted until result evidence is inspected.
